snippet.title: American Truck Simulator - Introducing British Columbia
snippet.description:
Drive through Beautiful British Columbia for American Truck Simulator! Experience the stunning landscapes and vibrant culture of Canada’s westernmost province. From rich history to breathtaking scenery, British Columbia offers truckers an unforgettable journey through one of the most diverse regions in the country.

Add this map expansion to your Steam wishlist 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4057480/

Read more in our blog 👉 https://blog.scssoft.com/2025/10/introducing-british-columbia.html
